description.content: The `Application` is the base entity that is used to interact with the API and contains a collection of `Institution` objects. You can have multiple Applications associated with your account e.g. a production application with live access to each `Institution` and a development application with access to sandboxes.
Application Management endpoints help with creating and managing client sub-applications.
